analysis:
Examined all supplied documentation patches, text and file metadata against the canonical index and selected details. No implementation-level regression is established by this documentation-only scope. The changes describe availability fixes (separate PID-bound heartbeats, coordinator-caused ends excluded from failure counts, hourly approval retries), manual pair updates, catalog-alias omission, single-Mac min_p sampling, and stronger pre-disruption approval validation with speculative decoding restricted to local clusters.
Integration must verify: changelog.d/cluster-pair-coordinator-ends-not-failing.md:3-5 retries still enforce approval expiry, revocation and current connection bindings (T-053); docs/architecture/inference.md:3528-3535 heartbeat separation preserves registration supervision and private file handling (A-018, TB-003); :5230-5235 and :5250-5284 release-generated grants remain bound to exact installed artifacts, model identity and authoritative authorization rather than becoming serving permission themselves (A-017, T-052, T-054). changelog.d/cluster-release-runtime-facts.md:5 explicitly extrapolates evidence to whole mode families and arbitrary Apple silicon pairs despite missing pipeline/cross-cable records: reconcile this owner-approved policy with durable qualification requirements and threat-model coverage, without assuming coordinator acceptance or deployment. Verify two-member plaintext/cable custody and final-writer authorization contracts under TB-002/TB-007/TB-011.
Also verify catalog alias exclusion cannot transfer qualification between distinct manifests (changelog.d/cluster-runtime-facts-another-models-catalog-id.md:3-4), and full setup validation covers replans before teardown (inference.md:5372). No supplied changes establish altered encryption, cache isolation (T-041), billing, token custody or fan authority. Runtime and release-workflow source is absent here; the described controls and policy contracts remain unverified, not proven missing.
